기계공학의 기초 원리를 깊이 있게 탐구하고, 이를 실제 문제 해결로 잇는: We explore the fundamental principles of mechanical engineering in depth and cultivate converging capability across design, manufacturing, energy, robotics and metrology that connects those principles to real problems, producing engineers and core technologies that contribute to industry and society.
기계공학의 기초 지식과 이론을 바탕으로 유전자, 단백질, 세포 등의 생체: Building on the basic knowledge and theory of mechanical engineering, students learn to understand biological systems such as genes, proteins and cells, and study the principles of medical diagnostic and therapeutic devices based on mechanical engineering.
기계공학의 역학이론을 바탕으로 하여 생체시스템의 작동 원리를 이해하고 기: Working from the mechanics theory of mechanical engineering, students learn how biological systems operate and how to analyse them by mechanical engineering methods. The course develops an understanding of biological tissues and systems — cell mechanics, hemodynamics, the circulatory system, the respiratory system and the musculoskeletal system — and of the methods used to analyse them mechanically, and builds on this to introduce current applications such as tissue engineering and biomimetic engineering.

The course centres on the analysis and design of machine elements such as shafts, bearings, screws and gears on the basis of established theory, while also introducing newly emerging design methods.
